import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackCoordinateFibers
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectiveLinearFormRatios

/-!
# Linear combinations of pulled projective coordinates

Finite linear combinations of the pulled coordinate sections have explicit
ordinary-fiber values and coefficients in each pulled projective frame.
The coefficients may be arbitrary global functions on the source scheme.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {J : Type} [Fintype J]
  {X : Scheme.{u}} {M : X.Modules}

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

variable (f : X ⟶ Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k))
  (e : (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (twistingSheafOne (k := k) (J := J)) ≅ M)

/-- A finite combination of the homogeneous coordinates, transported through
the specified pullback isomorphism. -/
def coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso (c : J → Γ(X, ⊤)) : Γ(M, ⊤) :=
  ∑ j, c j • coordinateSectionOfIso f e j ⊤

/-- Ordinary-fiber evaluation takes each global-function coefficient to its
residue at the source point. -/
theorem coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso_fiberEvaluation
    (c : J → Γ(X, ⊤)) (x : X) :
    Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x (coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e c) =
      ∑ j, Scheme.Modules.globalToResidue X x (c j) •
        Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x (coordinateSectionOfIso f e j ⊤) := by
  simp only [coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso, map_sum, map_smulₛₗ]

omit [Fintype J] in
private theorem coordinateFrameOfIso_restrict_smul
    (i : J) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i)
    (c : Γ(X, ⊤)) (s : Γ(M, ⊤)) :
    ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op (c • s)) =
      V.topIso.inv (X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) c) *
        (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from
          ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
            (M.presheaf.map
              (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s)) := by
  rw [M.map_smul]
  let U : X.Opens := V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens)
  let r : Γ(X, U) := X.resHom le_top c
  let t : Γ(M, U) := M.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op s
  have hsmul := ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.val.app
    (op (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens))).hom.map_smul
      ((V.ι.appIso ⊤).hom.hom r) t
  change ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
      ((V.ι.appIso ⊤).inv.hom ((V.ι.appIso ⊤).hom.hom r) • t) =
    (V.ι.appIso ⊤).hom.hom r *
      (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from
        ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom t) at hsmul
  simp only [Scheme.Opens.ι_appIso, Iso.refl_hom, Iso.refl_inv,
    CommRingCat.hom_id] at hsmul
  change ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom (r • t) =
    (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from r) *
      (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from
        ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom t) at hsmul
  have hr : (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from r) =
      V.topIso.inv (X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) c) := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op).hom c =
      (X.presheaf.map (eqToHom (Scheme.Opens.ι_image_top V)).op).hom
        ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom c)
    rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← X.presheaf.map_comp]
    rfl
  exact hsmul.trans (congrArg (fun z : Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) => z *
    (show Γ(V.toScheme, ⊤) from
      ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom t)) hr)

/-- In a pulled standard frame, a linear combination has the corresponding
sum of restricted coefficients times pulled projective coordinate ratios. -/
theorem coordinateFrameOfIso_coordinateLinearCombination
    (c : J → Γ(X, ⊤)) (i : J) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i) :
    ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
            (coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e c)) =
      ∑ j, V.topIso.inv (X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) (c j)) *
        V.topIso.inv ((f.appLE (chart i) V hV).hom (coordinate i j)) := by
  simp only [coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso, map_sum,
    coordinateFrameOfIso_restrict_smul, coordinateFrameOfIso_coordinateSection_general]

/-- Base-field coefficients in a pulled linear combination restrict through the
source structure map, so the local frame formula has ordinary scalar
coefficients on every standard chart. -/
theorem coordinateFrameOfIso_scalarLinearCombination
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (c : J → k) (i : J) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i) :
    ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op
            (coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e
              (fun j => X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j)))) =
      ∑ j, V.topIso.inv (X.overAlgebraMap k V (c j)) *
        V.topIso.inv ((f.appLE (chart i) V hV).hom (coordinate i j)) := by
  rw [coordinateFrameOfIso_coordinateLinearCombination]
  congr 1
  funext j
  have hres : X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)
      (X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j)) = X.overAlgebraMap k V (c j) := by
    change (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op).hom
      (X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j)) = X.overAlgebraMap k V (c j)
    exact X.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k
      (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (c j)
  rw [hres]

/-- On a pulled standard chart, ordinary-fiber nonvanishing of a linear
combination is the basic open of its explicit local coefficient. -/
theorem coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff
    (c : J → Γ(X, ⊤)) (i : J) (V : X.Opens)
    (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ V) :
    Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x (coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e c) ≠ 0 ↔
      x ∈ X.basicOpen (∑ j, X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) (c j) *
        (f.appLE (chart i) V hV).hom (coordinate i j)) := by
  let y : V.toScheme := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let s := coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e c
  let a : Γ(X, V) := ∑ j, X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) (c j) *
    (f.appLE (chart i) V hV).hom (coordinate i j)
  have hres :
      Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj M) y
          (M.presheaf.map
            (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s) ≠ 0 ↔
        Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x s ≠ 0 := by
    exact Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation_restrict_ne_zero_iff V.ι M y s
  have hcoefficient :
      ((coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV).hom.app ⊤).hom
        (M.presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : V.ι ''ᵁ (⊤ : V.toScheme.Opens) ≤ ⊤)).op s) =
      V.topIso.inv a := by
    rw [coordinateFrameOfIso_coordinateLinearCombination]
    simp only [a, map_sum, map_mul]
  change Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x s ≠ 0 ↔ x ∈ X.basicOpen a
  rw [← hres, ModulePullbackFrames.fiberEvaluation_ne_zero_iff_isUnit_of_frame
    _ (coordinateFrameOfIso f e i V hV), hcoefficient]
  rw [← V.toScheme.mem_basicOpen _ y (by trivial)]
  rw [← Scheme.Opens.ι_image_basicOpen_topIso_inv (X := X) (U := V)]
  exact (Function.Injective.mem_set_image V.ι.isOpenEmbedding.injective).symm

omit [Fintype J] in
/-- Pulling a coefficient on a projective chart back along a morphism over
the base field gives the source structure scalar. -/
theorem appLE_awayScalar [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (hf : f ≫ (Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k 0)))) =
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (i : J) (V : X.Opens) (hV : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i) (c : k) :
    (f.appLE (chart i) V hV).hom
        ((Proj.awayToSection (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom
            (algebraMap k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
              (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) c)) =
      X.overAlgebraMap k V c := by
  let P := Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
  letI : P.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom
    (Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k 0))))
  have hscalar : P.overAlgebraMap k (chart i) c =
      (Proj.awayToSection (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
        (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom
          (algebraMap k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
            (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) c) := by
    unfold Scheme.overAlgebraMap
    change ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of k)).inv ≫
      (Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
          (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k 0)))).appTop ≫
      P.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : chart i ≤ ⊤)).op).hom c = _
    rw [structureMap_appTop_awayToSection, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
    rfl
  rw [← hscalar]
  exact Scheme.Hom.appLE_overAlgebraMap f hf hV c

/-- The ordinary fiber of a pulled linear form is nonzero exactly away from
the corresponding projective hyperplane. The morphism need only be over the
base field; no complete section basis or injectivity is assumed. -/
theorem scalarLinearCombinationOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff
    [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
    (hf : f ≫ (Proj.toSpecZero (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) ≫
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (algebraMap k (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k 0)))) =
      (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    (c : J → k) (x : X) :
    Scheme.Modules.fiberEvaluation M x
        (coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso f e
          (fun j => X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j))) ≠ 0 ↔
      f x ∈ Proj.basicOpen (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm c) := by
  have hcover : f x ∈ ⨆ i : J, chart (k := k) i := by rw [iSup_chart]; trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hcover
  let V : X.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ chart i
  rw [coordinateLinearCombinationOfIso_fiber_ne_zero_iff f e _ i V le_rfl x hi]
  have hcoeff : (∑ j, X.resHom (le_top : V ≤ ⊤) (X.overAlgebraMap k ⊤ (c j)) *
      (f.appLE (chart i) V le_rfl).hom (coordinate i j)) =
      (f.appLE (chart i) V le_rfl).hom
        (∑ j, (Proj.awayToSection (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom
            (algebraMap k (HomogeneousLocalization.Away
              (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k) (MvPolynomial.X i)) (c j)) *
          coordinate i j) := by
    simp only [map_sum, map_mul, appLE_awayScalar f hf]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j _
    congr 1
    exact X.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE (le_top : V ≤ ⊤)).op (c j)
  rw [hcoeff, Scheme.basicOpen_appLE, basicOpen_linearFormRatio]
  change (f x ∈ chart i ∧ f x ∈ chart i ∧ f x ∈
    Proj.basicOpen (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule J k)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm c)) ↔ _
  exact (and_iff_right hi).trans (and_iff_right hi)

end
end Hartshorne.ProjectiveTwist
